title: AgentNodesRegistry
description: Registry schema for remote and local machine profiles running Herdr Agent Gateway.

default_node.description: The primary preferred target node identifier. If not specified or unavailable, fallback_order is evaluated.

fallback_order.description: Ordered list of node identifiers to attempt when default_node is unspecified or fails health check.

endpoint.description: HTTP or HTTPS base URL of the gateway (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:9480 or http://100.80.20.10:9480).

auth_token.description: Bearer token string or environment variable reference (e.g. 'env:HERDR_GATEWAY_TOKEN').

ssh_key.description: SSH key configuration for public-key request signing authentication.

private_key_path.description: Path to local private SSH key used to sign requests.

default_workspace.description: Default workspace target on this machine if unspecified.

default_agent.description: Default agent kind to launch if unspecified.

enabled.description: Whether this node is eligible for dispatch.

priority.description: Numeric priority (lower number = higher priority) used when fallback_order is omitted.

health_check_path.description: Endpoint path to verify node health and reachability.

yolo_args.description: Custom YOLO auto-approval flags per agent type (e.g. {'pi': ['--yolo'], 'claude': ['--dangerously-skip-permissions']}).
